name: caveman
description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick — Claude Code skill that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like caveman
one_liner: A Claude Code add-on that makes the AI 'talk' in short, blunt phrases instead of polished sentences internally, cutting how many tokens (and dollars) each coding session costs.
buyer: A startup founder or agency running Claude Code heavily across a team, watching the monthly API bill climb, who wants the same output for meaningfully less spend.
business_use_cases: An agency running Claude Code across dozens of client projects installs it to cut its aggregate token spend.
A solo indie hacker using Claude Code daily adopts it to stretch a fixed monthly API budget further.
A dev-tools consultant offers a 'cut your AI coding bill' audit that includes installing and tuning it.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'AI coding cost reduction' audit for agencies and startups, using this and similar token-saving skills as the toolkit.

steal_this: Track one team's actual token spend before and after installing it for a week, then turn that real number into a cold-outreach pitch for cost-audit consulting.
